Application Data.NAME: Smith Asphalt & Paving Co.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith Asphalt & Paving Co. specializes in high-quality asphalt and paving services for residential, commercial, and municipal projects. Our operations include road construction, parking lot paving, and driveway installations. We utilize state-of-the-art equipment and skilled labor to ensure efficient and durable results. Due to the nature of our work, we are highly aware of the seasonal and weather-dependent factors that may impact project timelines, and we take proactive measures to mitigate potential disruptions. Safety is a top priority, and we adhere strictly to industry standards to protect our employees and clients.

Application Data.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Smith Asphalt & Paving Co. also owns and operates \"Springfield Paving Solutions,\" a separate service location focused on residential paving projects in a different area of Springfield, IL.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses incurred during the 2022 paving season included a slip and fall incident on April 10, resulting in a $25,000 claim; equipment damage from severe weather on June 15, totaling $75,000; and a third-party property damage claim from asphalt spillage on August 22, amounting to $50,000. All claims are currently pending resolution, with the total losses reported at $150,000.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security personnel on-site during business hours; perimeter fencing installed around main operational area; regular patrols conducted during high-risk project phases.
